name: prompt_for_privacy_policy_acceptance
description: Requests the user to accept the privacy policy before proceeding with assistance.

parameters.name: privacy_acceptance
parameters.description: User's acceptance of the privacy policy.

children.name: present_assistance_queries
children.description: Presents a list of available queries or assistance options the chatbot can provide for user inquiries, allowing the user to select their desired option.

outputs.description: Options for assistance including checking next trains, recommending fares, transport card information, directions to stations, checking network status, installation status, and other inquiries.

children.name: provide_current_network_status
children.description: Informs the user about the current status of the transport network, including details of incidents affecting specific lines and the operational status of all transport lines.

outputs.description: Details of current incidents affecting specific transport lines, including ongoing network incidents and the operational status of affected services.
Confirmation of operational status for the rest of the transport lines.

children.name: prompt_for_station_selection
children.description: Requests the user to specify the name of their current station for navigation assistance and relevant information.

parameters.name: station_name
parameters.description: Represents the name of the user's current station or location for directions.

children.name: present_train_line_options
children.description: Presents the available train or metro lines at a specified station for the user to choose from.

parameters.name: station_name
parameters.description: The name of the station whose line options are being inquired about.

outputs.description: List of available train lines at the specified station, including help for Line 1, Line 2, Line 3, Line 4, Line 5, and Line 10.
Details about connections available at the station.

children.name: present_upcoming_trains_info
children.description: Presents information about the next upcoming trains at a specified station, including line numbers, directions, and arrival times.

parameters.name: station_name
parameters.description: The name of the station provided by the user where upcoming trains are to be checked.

parameters.name: selected_line
parameters.description: The specific metro line the user wants to check for upcoming trains.

outputs.description: Details of the next trains arriving at the station, including line numbers, directions, arrival times, and waiting times.

name: provide_multi_card_purchase_information
description: The chatbot provides information on purchasing the Multi Card, including its cost and where to buy it.

outputs.description: The Multi Card costs 2.50 euros and can be bought at metro stations' automatic machines or authorized sales points.

name: prompt_for_language_selection
description: The chatbot asks the user to select their preferred language for communication.

parameters.name: language_option
parameters.description: The user's preferred language for communication.

name: provide_tourist_title_info
description: Gives detailed information about the Título Turístico, including its duration options and applicable zones.

outputs.description: Description of the validity periods for the Título Turístico
Descriptions of the normal and infant titles available based on user age
Information on how the title applies to different zones

name: guide_to_additional_information
description: The chatbot informs the user that it is a customer service channel and offers a link to the main website for additional information.
